small_guidance: Reduce register pressure to lift occupancy above 33%: shrink BLOCK_OC to 16 and BLOCK_SP to 32 (or try 16x64), and move the IC loop to the outer position so x_vals/w_vals tiles aren't kept live across kd/kh/kw. Add @triton.autotune over {(BLOCK_OC,BLOCK_SP)=(16,32),(16,64),(32,32),(32,64)} with num_warps in {2,4} and num_stages in {2,3}. Also fuse the BN-fold + spatial-mean-subtract epilogue (currently running cuDNN BN + an elementwise add + a reduce) into a single Triton pass on the conv output, since BN+mean-sub is ~17% of runtime.
large_guidance: Rewrite the ConvTranspose3d as a scatter-add GEMM: for each input voxel (n,ic,id,ih,iw), compute the input×kernel outer product over (OC, KD*KH*KW) and atomically scatter-add into output positions (od=id*SD-PD+kd, ...). One program per (N, IC tile, input-spatial tile) with BLOCK_IC=16, BLOCK_SP=32, BLOCK_OC=32, using channels_last layout so OC loads coalesce. This eliminates the per-output-element loop over (kd,kh,kw,ic) with divmod-based validity tests (currently ~98% L1 hit but compute-bound at 65% with low occupancy from 128 regs/thread). Bake the bias as the output initializer in a separate small kernel, and fuse the BN-fold (precomputed scale/shift) plus per-(n,c) spatial-mean subtraction into a single two-pass Triton kernel replacing cuDNN BN + elementwise + reduce.
